caption:
Restless, even when nothing is wrong? Read Qur'an 13:28 slowly.

Try this today:
→ two quiet minutes after each prayer
→ swap one scroll break for dhikr
→ say Alhamdulillah when you notice a blessing

Save this for a restless day.
